conflicts.description: Canonical recipe outer radius 8 mm conflicts with scan research RR=15 mm; scheduled 15 mm is cartridge socket radius only.
User-selected local-Y blade slide conflicts with source perpendicular-axis wording and an X-labeled tip coordinate.
The A-K upper blade spring anchors follow station-local u; BLUE reaches x=24.9 outside the unchanged housing x bound +22. Anchor interfaces and full sweep remain unresolved.

The direct station-frame servo body/pivot extend beyond the unchanged housing bounds. Reference layout: the 34 mm rod is rendered unstretched from y=-53.3 (crank shaft surface) to the carriage rear face y=-19.3, but the crank-pin circle (radius 5.2 about y=-54) only reaches y=-48.8 or -59.2 on the axis, so a 34 mm rod cannot join the crank pin to the carriage rear face at the closed carriage position (pin-to-rear distance 29.5 or 39.9 mm); the rod is not stretched. Rod endpoint coordinates and the mapping of the supplied slider-crank equation to carriage/pin positions remain unresolved.
The A-K cartridge tube is z=6..46 while the retained FR-031 recipe envelope is a distinct 12.8x10.4x40 value; cap/cartridge seating and clearances remain unresolved.
The closed pin carriage coordinate y=-14.8 lies 5.2 mm beyond the rail endpoint y=-20; retain both supplied placements without moving either.

A-K places a moving endpoint at e-52 and a fixed bracket at y=-68, shortening from 21.7 mm closed to 10.3 mm open. FR-033/SC-024 describes extension toward a positive-Y housing reaction pad. These descriptions of the same named spring conflict and are not reconciled.

The FR-031 12.8x10.4x40 mm recipe is retained as historical provenance only; the current user-requested 14.8 tangential x 12.4 radial x 40 mm envelope governs all four cartridges. Fit remains unresolved.
Two incompatible former visual read-point interpretations are retained as non-datum candidates; neither drives scanner visuals or hardware placement.

Tray walls/height are unspecified and the visual reference card has no assembly coordinate; no K envelope/no-overlap result is established. Historical K center [0,-13,-13.25] is preserved only as a rendered fallback candidate, not a current absolute tray position; the current 12 mm receiving-plane relation has unknown absolute outlet/tray Z.

A prior outlet X/Y axis-order assumption remains in the legacy station record for provenance only. The SC-028 stack does not use it; outlet orientation and aperture datum remain unresolved and no orientation is inferred.

The historical/source z bounds 20.5..34 mm are retained as a conflict candidate, not the current Pull Solenoid mesh bounds. The user-requested 16x8x10 mm box centered at z=27.25 has rendered bounds 22.25..32.25 mm; no source datum reconciles them.

The requested 29.5x20.6x23.9 mm lower pull-solenoid envelope, approximate z center -0.75 mm, canonical -Y pull, missing axis/mount datums, and nearby station structure do not establish a feasible or non-obstructing installation. Exact source pose/contact is null; any overlap remains exposed, not cleared or fitted. Display-fallback layout (user reference model, not validated): the 29.5x20.6x23.9 mm body sits behind the spring bracket (y -99.5..-70, x/z centered 0/-0.75, x 20.6 wide, z 23.9 tall); the 28 mm display plunger (dia 1 mm, y -74.3..-46.3) passes through a 1.4 mm bracket hole to the moving carriage whose rear face is y=e-52 (-46.3 closed); the return spring spans -68..-46.3 closed (center y -57.15, 21.7 mm; 10.3 mm open). The plunger, carriage and strap are unsourced schematic sizes (dia 1 mm plunger vs the reference 7.93 mm; spring radius 0.75 mm vs the reference 4.9 mm), so the spring end does not seat on a real bracket land. These conflicts are flagged, not resolved.

The 12.8x5.8x6.5 mm Microswitch is integrated under Pin Carriage. A rotated display fallback keeps the carriage recipe bounds at z=14..20 mm, but its actual mount, axis orientation, and fit are not supplied.

The user-supplied reference layout removes every unlisted component-level AABB overlap, but exposes: servo body (x +-6.1, y -71.2..-48.2) and its pivot beyond the nominal housing footprint; the carriage-rail endpoint y=-20 versus carriage rear y=-19.3 (rod/rail-end relation); the 34 mm rod that cannot join crank pin to carriage rear (servo-pivot-rod-closure); the BLUE blade spring (x 22..27.8) outside housing x +22; blade tabs sweeping beyond the 24.65 mm tower keep-out circle; scanner housing height 9 mm versus the reference 11.8 mm; and display-scale plunger/spring versus the reference 7.93/10.7 mm parts. The overlap audit is AABB bookkeeping, not a clearance result.

Earlier wording treats the central post/axle as a fixed element the drum rides on. The under-base direct drive turns the drum through the central axis, so the post/axle must become a keyed rotating shaft. The Central Post component stays a fixed 46 mm cylinder in this concept; the shaft/post/drum key, bearing and support split is unresolved and the spec wording change is recorded here rather than applied silently.

The Outlet Tray was shortened from the inferred 58 mm to 50 mm (footprint x -20..20, y -42..8, centre y -17) so the stepper shaft path and mount plate clear it; the 58 mm scan-text value is superseded in the rendered concept only.

conflict_notes.description: The prior corrected A-K coordinates, parents, rail/carriage relationship, servo placement, blade spring placements and tongue spring endpoints remain historical assumptions. The new SC-027 chain records do not convert them into validated contacts or silently move parts.

The new SC-027 user topology supersedes the prior A-K tongue-edge spring path and the 21.7/10.3 mm lengths for the current chain: the existing Tongue Return Spring is now represented around the lower plunger between the moving carriage and fixed Station Housing bracket. Former coordinates/lengths remain historical conflicts; no working spring geometry or contact is claimed.

SC-027 asks for each blade spring to a fixed reaction feature, while the existing per-color spring placements/parents follow the rotating A-K station frames and include out-of-housing conflicts. The graph names candidate fixed seats but does not reconcile the conflict or assert contact.
